newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares ease, seen rising later in week.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares ease, seen rising later in week.

text.p: Russian shares eased slightly on Monday as profit-taking from domestic players brought prices down from Friday afternoon's rally, traders said.
They said prices could rise again later in the week.

"Shares that were doing well on Friday are simply not holding up today, although there's still a big temptation to go for short-term profit," said Sergei Kosyukin, head trader at Menatep Bank. "They're overdoing it again this morning - prices are almost back to Thursday levels."
Energy giant United Energy Systems (UES) ordinaries were selling on the Russian Trading System at $0.2041 at 1125 GMT on Monday, down from $0.2110 at close on Friday.
Some traders said they expected the market to continue to ease for the next few days but to rally later in the week.
"I don't think that the market has reached bottom yet but I also don't think that it will fall very far," said Andrei Galperin, senior trader at Kreditanstalt-Grant.
"We might even see a rally this week since there are always buyers at this level."
